issues_encountered: r2 stated the two dft_clk_switch handshake synchronisers cannot be listed under required_synchronisers and are enforced elsewhere: INVALIDATED. Root cause of cdc_snitch 'BAD magic': cdc_snitch counts input PINS in the launch cone (len(dom_in)==1 needed for CDC), a latch has E and D, so a latch (even single-domain) or any 2-input logic in front of a magic_cdc stage is BAD magic. Reproduced with a 4-source reproducer (flop->CDC, single-domain latch->BAD, AND2 of two flops->BAD, latch registered by a flop->CDC)
